description: Preview and correct category, business purpose or user-supplied attendees on one or more exact expenses; first search_expenses for full expenseIds. Automatic preview with confirm omitted/false: show exact count and before/after changes, ask approval once, then repeat identical operationId/selection/change with confirm:true; early confirm returns preview. Never infer attendee names/business context. attendeeMode add preserves existing attendees; replace changes only that Notes segment. Preserve card, description, inbox and other structured Notes segments; skip Formula Notes/overflow. Terminal result gives applied/conflicted/failed counts, status and Undo. Does not omit duplicates, change amounts/dates or do broad Calendar matching; omit/restore via omit_expenses; one row's merchant or tag: update_expense. Mixed (e.g. category plus attendees), unsupported or over-100-row cleanup: https://www.expensebot.ai/review-expenses?source=mcp.

change.description: Exactly one correction; its type selects the required value field.

attendeeMode.description: add unless the user asks to replace existing attendees.

attendees.description: Names the user supplied when type is attendees; never infer names.

businessPurpose.description: User-supplied purpose when type is businessPurpose.

category.description: Configured category when type is category.

type.description: Correction kind applied to every selected expense.

confirm.description: Omit/false for preview; true only after explicit approval.

operationId.description: Idempotency key generated once and reused unchanged.

selection.description: Exact expenses from search_expenses approved for this correction.

items.description: One receipt identity per expense; never broaden after preview.

expected.description: Optional search values for conflict detection.

name: correct_expenses
